title: Becoming lucid in Mall World?
content: Last night I was in Mall World again and I felt myself become aware of where I was. Down the corridor that usually leads to the abandoned food court, there was a giant yellow ball pit. Then, I wanted to take pictures for proof that I was there. I was in one of the main areas that leads to one of the larger department stores and it was completely empty, but as soon as I got out my phone to take a picture, people started coming towards me and that’s about when I woke up. There were a few other things that happened before that, but unfortunately I forgot since I woke up this morning.
